visual_synopsis: A mustachioed man in a white undershirt clutches his head and grimaces in his bedroom, bites into a red apple and then lies motionless on the bed with the apple on his chest. The rest plays out in a blown-out white afterlife with Armenian signs reading 'hell' and 'paradise' on the walls, where the man - now in a black suit and pale tie - pleads his case straight to camera while a curly-haired angel in a white bow tie and feathered wings processes him on a winged laptop at a small desk, until the man finally walks up to the desk.
